bindings.variant: measure; CtcDecodeTrace with core and clock probes at decode start, beam start and end

findings: Root cause: core placement. Standalone CTC started on a mid core on 100% of rows. Fused CTC on LibreBoardLiveSwipe started on a little core on 83% of rows (79% still little at beam start), at the little cluster's 820 MHz idle clock, and changed cluster mid-decode on 83%.

On the same cluster the work costs the same: beam starting on mid, fused CPU p50 123.9 ms (105 rows) vs standalone 121.3 ms (499 rows); fused starting little 168.0 ms (395 rows). Mid-start CPU at the standalone cpu/wall ratio projects to ~129 ms wall against 187 ms observed, consistent with placement explaining the whole ~59 ms gap.
Cache locality is ruled out: fused decodes starting on the very core the standalone decode just used were not faster (137 vs 117 ms CPU p50, 32 vs 55 rows).

Mechanism: the decoder thread idles between swipes, its utilization decays, and the energy-aware scheduler wakes it on a little core. The busy harness thread stays on mid cores, so standalone CTC latency is optimistic for production.
limitations: Diagnostic only; releaseEligible is false. The measure APK (non-debuggable, testOnly, ART speed) is not the pinned debugNoMinify APK, and the swipe model is a candidate, not the pinned model.
Swipe shard 1/3 of build/model-data/swipe-latin-v1/test.jsonl, first rows only; every run here replays the same row ids, so cross-run comparisons share rows but not device state.
Cross-run drift is about ±10% in CPU time (phone temperature 34–38 °C across the session); arm comparisons within one run are the reliable ones.

The instrumentation process runs in the /foreground cpuset (cores 0–6, no big core) and AOSP Instrumentation runs the harness thread at nice −8 (THREAD_PRIORITY_URGENT_DISPLAY). A visible IME may be scheduled differently; a live-keyboard measurement is still owed.
latencyMs times the suggestion call only, not end-to-end IME latency. Each row also runs standalone geometric (1500 ms budget) and standalone CTC before fused_swipe.

CtcDecodeTrace placement probes read /proc and sysfs at decode start and end; that adds about 5 ms to fused_swipe (slot-plus-decoder overhead 1.8 → 6.7 ms p50), so absolute fused_swipe latencies here read slightly high.
scope: Diagnostic 500-row attribution of the fused CTC CPU-time gap to core placement or cache locality.
